# Midstate Basement Authorities

> > Professional basement waterproofing, foundation repair, and crawl space services for Northern Pennsylvania and Central New York.

Midstate Basement Authorities Inc., led by Robert Leach and Eric Leach, provides comprehensive basement and foundation solutions including structural repairs, drainage systems, and mold prevention. The company serves communities across Northern PA and NY including Ithaca, Binghamton, Macedon, and Canton with proven waterproofing techniques and carbon fiber reinforcement systems.

## Key Topics

- Basement Waterproofing
- Foundation Repair
- Crawl Space Encapsulation
- Northern Pennsylvania & Central New York Service Area
- Drainage Systems & Sump Pumps
- Bowed Wall Repair & Carbon Fiber Straps
- Mold Prevention
- Water Damage Prevention
- Structural Foundation Repair
- Interior Drainage Solutions
- Robert Leach & Eric Leach
- Freeze-Thaw Damage Protection
- Vapor Barriers
- Wall Crack Repair

## Core Services

- [Basement Repair](https://midstatebasement.com/basement-repair): Main basement repair service page with free inspection contact form
- [Crawl Space Waterproofing](https://midstatebasement.com/crawl-space-waterproofing-4): Crawl space waterproofing & encapsulation with vapor barriers & drainage
- [Crawl Space Repair](https://midstatebasement.com/crawl-space-repair): Crawl space repair services for Northern PA & NY foundations
- [Bowed Wall Repair](https://midstatebasement.com/bowed-wall-repair): Bowed basement wall repair using carbon fiber straps & wall anchors
- [Sump Pump Installation](https://midstatebasement.com/sump-pump-installation): Sump pump installation for basement flood prevention & water removal
